Begin with both faces directed approximately toward the camera, relaxed and with natural slight smiles. In the first second, Clara turns only her eyes and chin slightly toward a fixed point just off-screen camera-left at eye level. Andre initially keeps his gaze forward. After Clara completes this small turn, Andre turns his eyes and chin toward that same off-screen point. During the final second, both hold this shared camera-left gaze with relaxed expressions. The head turns are small, at most about 30 degrees, retaining visible three-quarter faces. They do not look at each other. Their bodies remain in place, arms relaxed, without walking, touching or handling objects. The camera is mounted on a locked tripod throughout: constant position, constant focal length and fixed framing, with no push-in, zoom, pan, tilt or orbit. Keep the apparent size and screen positions of both people and the farmhouse and barn constant. Preserve each character's face, hairstyle and clothing. One uninterrupted shot, no cut, no dialogue, no additional people, no text or logos.
